name: SLS Barcelona
positioning: Lively waterfront hotel on the marina at Port Forum, the SLS brand's first hotel in Europe
best_for: Travelers who want a social waterfront base with rooftop pools in summer and a cocktail-bar scene
Festival-goers heading to Primavera Sound at the Parc del Forum

facts.text: The hotel is set on the marina at Port Forum, steps from the beach.
SLS Barcelona is the SLS brand's first hotel in Europe.
The building was designed by b720 Fermin Vazquez Arquitectos.
Cosmico is a rooftop pool club and restaurant with a Japanese-inspired menu, cocktails and DJ sessions.
Deluxe, in the lobby, changes from a cafe by day to a lounge bar at night.
Lora, off the lobby, serves cuisine inspired by the Mediterranean coast.
Kyara is a post-modern cocktail bar on the hotel's fifth floor.
Guests who book a treatment at Halcyon Spa get 90 minutes of access to the spa facilities.
The hotel has a light-filled waterfront gym open 24/7.
The Euphoria Apartment has a kitchenette with stove, oven, microwave and mini-fridge.
Coral, the ground-level pool, is family-friendly.
The whole hotel was designed to be accessible to guests with limited mobility.

highlights.text: Kyara is the first project in Spain from mixologists Monica Berg and Alex Kratena.
Halcyon Spa has an immersive jacuzzi where cinematic visuals surround the space and a rain shower falls from above.
Every room and suite has a balcony or terrace, and many have views of the marina and the Mediterranean.
The Parc del Forum, where the Primavera Sound festival is held, is a few steps away, and the hotel is an official partner of the festival.
A pink neon-lit hallway off the lobby leads to the port.

considerations.text: The two rooftop infinity pools operate in the summer season; Coral, the ground-level boardwalk pool, is open year-round.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the luxury positioning.
